lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p28 - Listen to the conversation. Act it out.

details: Listen to the conversation introduces students to the structure It’s an/a…, It’s/They’ve got… and reviews the target language from the previous lesson. Act it out allows students to practise using the target language in a natural way, and to practise working with a partner.
Look for careful listening and accurate pointing to the items in the picture as students hear them, as well as accurate pronunciation, and participation.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p28 - Complete the sentences. Write and colour.

details: Complete the sentence and write gives  students controlled practice of the target language while strengthening their counting skills. Colour allows students to practise colour vocabulary.
Look for correct counting and spelling, consistent letter formation, and neat handwriting and colouring within the lines.
